title: Integral Verdier compatibility predicate
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$ with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, and a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $X$. Use the coefficient categories, derived tensor and internal Hom, and constructible exceptional functors of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Fix a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, $R=\mathcal O_E$, and a coherent dualizing presentation $(\omega,r)$ of [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum]. Define the integral Verdier conclusion predicate for these data by requiring ordinary tensor presentations, signed symmetries and normalized reduction presentations; equality of bounded constructibility with uniform finite Tor amplitude; preservation and exact anti-equivalence for $D_R=R\mathcal Hom(-,\omega)$; invertibility of the evaluation-defined finite reduction comparisons; the evaluation, all-adjunction-transpose and transition-evaluation equations; reconstruction by the derived-limit Roos triangle of the restricted finite duals; and the actual evaluation-defined biduality map, natural and invertible and compatible with reduction. Its uniform bound clause quantifies over every $d\ge0$ with $\dim X\le d$, every $a\le b$, and every constructible $K$ whose reductions have Tor amplitude $[a,b]$: all reductions of $D_RK$ have Tor amplitude $[-b-2d,-a]$. This is a predicate, not its assertion.
